messages:
Devin Patel: quick question — pinging for approvals on https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/378 :point_up:
Devin Patel: PR touches runtime/kv-cache (owned by runtime-team) and infra/k8s (owned by infra-team). CODEOWNERS makes both required — who can actually approve to unblock merging?
Alexandra Kim: ah yeah mixed dirs. If both owners required, we need an infra + runtime approval. Did you try adding temporary approvers on the PR description? /cc @priyanka"
Priyanka Nair: I can review the runtime bits today, but I don't have infra approvals. If @ryan can eyeball the k8s change we can merge after both LGTM.
Ryan Sato: I'm infra oncall this week — I can do a quick pass. Expect a couple of nits on resource requests.
Devin Patel: thanks all. timeline: would like to merge before EOD to include in the staging deploy. If full infra review will take longer, would it be ok to get a temporary approver so runtime can land?
Alexandra Kim: temporary approver requires an exemption in the PR or a codeowners override. We try not to do overrides unless it's urgent. Is this urgent for staging?
Devin Patel: it's mostly performance-safe, small kv cache TTL tweak. Staging test shows no regressions. Not urgent critical, but release cadence prefers it in today's batch.
Priyanka Nair: +1 from runtime side after a quick run of unit tests. posting the diff snippet for context:
```
diff --git a/runtime/kv/cache.py b/runtime/kv/cache.py
index 9f1..a3b 100644
-    TTL = 30
+    TTL = 45
```
Ryan Sato: skimming infra k8s manifest now. If it's just bumping resource limits or annotations I'm fast. If it mutates PVCs or networkpolicies that'll need deeper review.
Devin Patel: infra change is here: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/commit/abc123
Devin Patel: it's an annotations/limits tweak only, no schema changes.
Ryan Sato: OK I can approve. Leaving 1 comment about cpu requests, but not blocking.
Ryan Sato: LGTM (after updating cpu request from 100m -> 150m) :white_check_mark:
Priyanka Nair: LGTM from runtime side too.
Devin Patel: awesome, thanks! Merging now.
deploy-bot: staging CI passed for PR #378 — all checks green. :rocket:
Devin Patel: merged and kicking off staging deploy. I'll follow-up if anything pops in staging. :pray:
